understanding: The supplied code resolves the leader-local commitment producer and its commit-channel consumer. setupLeaderState creates a fresh commitment object with voter reports initialized to zero and startIndex set to the sampled last index plus one. Under its mutex, commitment advances an aggregate index from reported voter matches, subject to startIndex, before requesting notification. leaderLoop reads that aggregate, publishes it, and passes eligible inflight futures to processLogs. These observations establish bookkeeping and call boundaries, not actual durable quorum storage or FSM execution.
